title: Home
text: Looking for the full Loopmark experience? Visit the Loopmark website for product overview, pricing, and FAQs. Open-source LangGraph marketing agent Social content, email campaigns, audience research, lead funnel management, and auto-posting, from a Python CLI you self-host with your own API keys. Get started Loopmark website Star on GitHub Complaints agent Log, classify, draft responses, and resolve customer complaints. Posting agent Generate social posts, emails, calendars, and publish to Twitter, LinkedIn, or Buffer. Funnel agent Score leads, move prospects through stages, and plan nurture sequences. Audience research Analyze websites, import CRM segments, and draft personas for campaigns. Why Loopmark Agent? MIT licensed; run locally with JSON storage and BYOK credentials LangGraph router sends each request to the right specialist agent Programmatic API via run_agent() for backends and automations

title: Features
text: Features Three specialist agents plus audience research tools, all driven in plain English. Complaints Log and classify complaints by severity Draft empathetic responses Track resolution stats Posting & content Platform-specific social posts (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, blog) Email campaigns with A/B subject lines and drip sequences Content calendars and hashtag suggestions Auto-publish via Twitter, LinkedIn, or Buffer scheduler Funnel Eight funnel stages with lead scoring Source reporting and nurture playbooks Audience research Save a reusable business profile Analyze a website URL for persona signals Import CRM CSV/JSON segments Persist audience personas for campaigns Audience workflow · Data collection, limits & PII

title: Install
text: Installation Python 3.10+ and an OpenAI API key. Optional social credentials for live posting. pip install pip install loopmark-agent export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-your-key loopmark-agent chat loopmark-agent stats Data files are written to ./data in your working directory. Override with DATA_DIR . From source git clone https://github.com/loopmark-opensource/loopmark-agent.git cd loopmark-agent python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate pip install -e . cp .env.example .env loopmark-agent chat Optional integrations Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Buffer: set credentials in .env Local scheduler: python scheduler.py for due posts

title: Audience research
text: Audience research Build personas from your website, CRM exports, and saved business profile. No ad-platform APIs required. Workflow Save your product, tone, and target audience with the business profile tools Analyze your website URL to extract headings, copy, and positioning Import CRM segments (CSV or JSON) with industry, job title, and tags Generate draft personas with pain points, goals, and platform preferences What is not included Loopmark Agent does not connect to Meta Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, or follower analytics APIs in the OSS edition. Audience research here means website + CRM + AI personas. Data collection & limits This is not large-scale web scraping. Audience research uses small, user-initiated fetches to help draft marketing personas. What the agent may fetch Website URL (you provide) : one HTTP GET of public HTML per analysis. We parse title, meta tags, headings, and body copy. Response size is capped; requests time out after a few seconds. Social profile links on that site : optional follow-up GET of public profile pages (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, etc.) to read Open Graph / title / description when available. Many platforms return login walls; we mark those as blocked and do not bypass authentication. CRM files (you upload) : CSV or JSON you export from your own CRM. Nothing is pulled from third-party CRM APIs in the OSS edition. Business profile (you enter) : product name, tone, audience description, website URL stored locally for reuse. What we do not do No crawling sitemaps, search results, or competitor databases at scale No ad-platform or social analytics APIs (followers, ad spend, lookalikes) No circumventing rate limits, CAPTCHAs, or login walls No resale or sharing of fetched or imported data Operational limits (self-hosted) Volume is intentionally low (on-demand, per user action). If you deploy for many users or geos, you are responsible for robots.txt, site terms, request politeness, and infrastructure (including proxies) where appropriate. PII & privacy When you self-host Loopmark Agent, you are responsible for how personal data is collected, stored, and processed. The OSS agent stores data locally under data/ (JSON files) unless you integrate your own backend. Where PII can appear Feature Typical fields Storage CRM import Name, email, company, job title, tags, segment data/ (imported rows / personas) Funnel / leads Name, email, company, notes, score data/leads.json Complaints Customer name, email, message data/complaints.json Website analysis Usually no individual PII; public marketing copy only Transient / persona drafts Social public fetch Public bio/title text only when pages are accessible Enrichment on analysis result Third parties OpenAI : persona and content tools may send website excerpts, CRM summaries, or messages you provide to the model API. Review OpenAI’s policies and use enterprise / zero-retention options if your compliance program requires them. Twitter, LinkedIn, Buffer : only when you configure publishing; not used for audience scraping. Recommendations Do not commit data/ , CRM exports, or .env to git. Import the minimum CRM columns needed (avoid full contact dumps when anonymized segments are enough). Honor GDPR, CCPA, and local rules for consent, retention, and deletion when processing customer or lead data. Redact or delete JSON files when offboarding users or closing a deployment. Questions from partners or reviewers? Point them to this page and the README section .

title: API
text: Programmatic API Use core.run.run_agent() from Python backends, scripts, or a future hosted API. from core.run import run_agent result = run_agent("Draft a LinkedIn post about our product launch") print(result.reply) print(result.intent) # posting | complaint | funnel Reference v1.0.0 Generated from core/run.py docstrings. class AgentResult Structured response from a single agent turn. Fields reply: str intent: str messages: list[BaseMessage] run_agent(message: str, history: Sequence[BaseMessage] | None=None, *, model: str | None=None) -> AgentResult Run one turn of the marketing agent graph. Args message : User input text. history : Optional prior conversation messages for multi-turn chat. model : Optional OpenAI model override (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Returns AgentResult with reply text, routed intent, and full message history. CLI equivalent loopmark-agent chat loopmark-agent stats The CLI wraps the same graph via main.py . Hosted REST endpoints are tracked separately for the paid layer.
